source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing supplies a system principal only when the existing external-link wrapper reaches loadURI with a null or undefined principal. A caller principal or the no-prompt branch's constructed permission-bearing principal survives the final nullish assignment. Protocol prompt decisions and history insertion remain separate. The checked test and mock assert URI/history behavior, not the triggering principal or native permission outcome. No native protocol launch or security-isolation result was executed.
title: External-link dispatch adds a principal only after the existing permission branches
